whole_program_traceability_coverage.title: Whole-program requirement-to-evidence-to-acceptance traceability coverage
whole_program_traceability_coverage.statement: The end-to-end trace binding every institutional outcome through requirement, use case, experience, architecture, data, work package, test, operational obligation, evidence requirement, and acceptance authority to a release gate, with every orphaned link recorded as an identified gap.
whole_program_traceability_coverage.prohibited_inference: A requirement traced to a gate is not a requirement met, and no missing link may be silently treated as complete.
